_comment: GGUF models baked into the installer. 'file' MUST match the exact filename in your models folder (KOBE_MODELS_DIR, e.g. C:\KobeOS\Models) or in models/bundled/. 'name' is the Ollama model name created on first boot and MUST match DEFAULT_MODEL_ROUTING.everyday in server/src/ai/ai-router.ts. 'default' is the model the Ask Kobe assistant talks to. Optional 'url' downloads the gguf on a GitHub-hosted runner.
_size_budget: GitHub caps release assets at 2 GiB. This model is 1065 MiB and only fits because scripts/download-ollama.cjs drops Ollama's CUDA libraries (1738 MiB of its 1863 MiB bundle) — setting OLLAMA_KEEP_GPU_LIBS=1 puts them back and will push the installer over the limit. The 'installer fits the release asset limit' step in build-windows.yml enforces this.
